name: @kyntocg/capsule-cli
description: Capsule CLI: deploy apps, manage databases, workers and crons, account/project/deploy variables with secrets, CI/CD for GitHub Actions and Forgejo, Git linking, project members, previews, extra TCP ports, backups, and database/IP firewall control. Object storage (S3-compatible, self-managed), VPN Connector and functions in the tunnel. Includes a ready-to-paste guide for AI agents.
